author: Edu Lazaro
description: A POP3 client in plain PHP: SSL or STARTTLS, certificate checks you control, password, APOP or OAuth sign-in, unique ids, headers or whole messages, and deletion only when asked. No extensions, no dependencies.

author: Joaquín Gamboa
description: Laravel driver for Amazon Aurora DSQL: IAM token auth, DSQL-compatible schema builder (inline PK/FK, ASYNC indexes, identity) and migration helpers.
Hashing unit - native digests, HMAC and timing-safe comparison, on the patterns/unit contract.
Password-hashing unit - Argon2id, Argon2i and bcrypt via PHP's password_* functions, on the patterns/unit contract.
